description: Structural invariants extracted from 609 corpus workflows. Applied deterministically by apply_fragments() in pipeline_stages.py before WirerAgent.

fragments.name: WhileActivity condition
fragments.corpus_evidence: 609/609 while loops in corpus use Condition={x:Null}
fragments.notes: WhileActivity iterates until ExitWhile fires — Condition is always null.

fragments.name: ExitWhile invariants
fragments.notes: whileSequenceActivity is resolved from traversal context, not a static value.

fragments.name: ExitWhile counter wiring
fragments.trigger: GetRowsCount precedes parent WhileActivity in same scope
fragments.corpus_evidence: Counter always references a GetRowsCount xName — confirmed across all while workflows
fragments.notes: Resolved from traversal context. Multiple WhileActivities each wire to their own nearest GetRowsCount.

fragments.name: GetCellValue row number wiring
fragments.trigger: activity is inside a WhileActivity body
fragments.corpus_evidence: 188 corpus uses of WhileActivity xName as RowNumber vs 83 uses of ExitWhile xName
fragments.notes: Known active bug: pipeline was generating %exitWhile1% instead of %whileActivity1%. This fragment fixes it permanently.

fragments.name: MemorySet defaults
fragments.corpus_evidence: Dominant in 98%+ of corpus MemorySet instances
fragments.notes: setdefault used — WirerAgent can override for the rare Global scope case.

fragments.name: ReturnValue default branch
fragments.corpus_evidence: 1,239 ReturnValue instances in mined_ifelse_conditions.json use these defaults
fragments.notes: Applied first. F7/F8 override Type/UseStoredValue when context warrants.

fragments.name: ReturnValue status tier
fragments.trigger: preceding activity before IfElseActivity is a Status producer
fragments.corpus_evidence: Known active bug: Ping workflows generating UserDefinedValue instead of StoredValue
fragments.notes: Overrides F6 when IfElse is checking a boolean/status result. Requires Step 2 registry for full accuracy but status_producers list covers common cases.

fragments.name: ReturnValue numeric tier
fragments.trigger: preceding activity before IfElseActivity is a Scalar producer
fragments.corpus_evidence: Scalar-checking IfElse branches consistently use UserDefinedValue type
fragments.notes: Overrides F6 when IfElse is comparing a numeric or string value.
